# test_snake_to_camel.py

import pytest

from your_module import snake_to_camel  # Replace `your_module` with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_value", "expected"),
    [
        # Happy path
        ("hello_world", "helloWorld"),
        ("snake_to_camel", "snakeToCamel"),
        ("a_b_c", "aBC"),

        # Already camel / no underscores
        ("helloWorld", "helloWorld"),
        ("hello", "hello"),

        # Edge cases
        ("", ""),
        ("_", ""),
        ("__", ""),
        ("_leading", "Leading"),
        ("trailing_", "trailing"),
        ("multiple__underscores", "multipleUnderscores"),
        ("a__b", "aB"),

        # Numbers and mixed content
        ("version_2_id", "version2Id"),
        ("user_123_name", "user123Name"),

        # Case behavior: capitalize() lowercases the rest of each later part
        ("HELLO_WORLD", "HELLOWORLD"),
        ("hello_WORLD_test", "helloWorldTest"),
        ("hELLO_wORLD", "hELLOWorld"),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel(input_value, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(input_value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_value", "expected_exception"),
    [
        (None, AttributeError),
        (123, AttributeError),
        (["hello_world"], AttributeError),
        ({"hello": "world"}, AttributeError),
        (b"hello_world", TypeError),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_invalid_input(input_value, expected_exception):
    with pytest.raises(expected_exception):
        snake_to_camel(input_value)
